format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (.aspx.cs behind code)
description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that displays and updates student answers for a specific course. It retrieves answers from a database, displays them, allows submission of grades, and manages session-based navigation.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: A partial class that inherits from System.Web.UI.Page, handling page load events, button clicks, data retrieval, and updates related to student answers and grades.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves student answers from the database for questions 1 to 5, and displays them in respective UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from input fields, updates the student's answer record in the database, deletes their entry from 'theoryCourseQueue', and navigates to AdminCourseQueue.aspx, confirming submission.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to LoginPage.aspx.
